application.name: KILN desktop studio
application.summary: Browser-local music creation: factory and user notes plus imported audio feed project tracks, the shared Web Audio mixer, and local MP3/WAV downloads. There are no application SQL transformations or warehouse tables.

integration.access_control: Public sanitized application structure only. No user project names, tags, audio, credentials or filesystem paths are exposed by the documentation view.

assurance.environment: Browser-local KILN; repository inspection, no warehouse
assurance.scope: Studio project metadata, library object store, track-source object store, Web Audio rendering and file downloads. Platform auth/database helpers are not studio data consumers.
limitations: The table-centric validator has no browser-object-store applicability mode. Its table/Platinum/consumer/snapshot requirements are intentionally not satisfied with fabricated analytical datasets.
No warehouse schema snapshot or transformation SQL exists because the studio has no warehouse or application SQL.
Audio remains local and is not inspected in deployed users' browsers. Browser storage retention is not guaranteed.

review.summary: Final desktop studio review: 20 isolated browser checks cover atomic library metadata, independent audio copies, portable project restoration, audible stereo MP3/WAV, 128-bar rendering, region phase and movement, live graph continuity, actionable missing-source retries and lineage navigation. Data remains browser-local; no warehouse tables, columns or SQL exist. Non-tabular strict-certification gap remains explicit.

evidence.reference: Project model and validated versioned portable interchange
evidence.summary: Project metadata, numeric bounds, track/clip/region contracts and embedded sample envelope are validated before import.

evidence.reference: IndexedDB library sound storage and separate track-source storage
evidence.summary: Library originals and metadata are stored in kiln-library.sounds. Project originals are copied into kiln-samples.buffers under new track IDs.

evidence.reference: Shared live and offline Performer; local LAME MP3 encoding
evidence.summary: Project notes and decoded source audio feed per-track effects and the stereo master. Offline rendering uses the same graph and downloads encoded PCM or MP3.

evidence.reference: Isolated browser integration check executed October 19, 2026
evidence.summary: 20 isolated browser checks verified library search/favorites and concurrent metadata updates, project-audio copy and backup roundtrip, reload persistence, decoded non-silent stereo MP3/WAV, 128-bar rendering, region movement and phase-preserving splitting, live graph continuity, missing-source retries and visible lineage navigation.

gaps.subject: Table-centric strict lineage assurance
gaps.reason: This application uses browser object stores, not relational or analytical tables. There is no real Platinum dataset, SQL transformation, warehouse schema snapshot or table-access consumer to certify.
gaps.next_action: Define an approved non-tabular applicability contract before requesting strict table-lineage certification. Until then retain partial assurance, documented browser flow and executable application tests; do not invent tables or SQL.

browser_stores.origin: factory project, user edits, or validated portable project
browser_stores.notes: No audio bytes, playing state or undo snapshots are persisted here.

browser_stores.origin: User-selected local audio; duration measured by browser decoder; user-entered name/tags/favorite; system-generated ID/date
browser_stores.notes: Reusable originals. Deleting a library record does not delete project-source copies.

browser_stores.origin: Copied library source, direct file/microphone input, or validated portable audio
browser_stores.notes: Decoded audio and waveform peaks are transient in-memory derivatives. One source per audio track.
